description_en: Creates an associated domain name for an edge container application. When a user sends a request from a client to access the associated domain name, the request is forwarded to the edge application deployed by the user
description_zh: 创建边缘容器应用的关联域名，用户从客户端发起请求访问关联的域名，请求最终会被转发到用户的部署的边缘应用
kebab_example: aliyun esa create-edge-container-app-record --app-id app-880688675783790000 --record-name a.example.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateEdgeContainerAppRecord

parameters.help_en:
The site ID.
<notice>Although this parameter is marked as optional in the schema, it is required when you call this operation. If you do not specify this parameter, an InternalError(400) error is returned. Call the ListSites operation to obtain a valid SiteId.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
站点ID。
<notice>此参数虽在 schema 中标记为可选，但实际调用时为必填项，省略将导致 InternalError(400)，请通过 ListSites API 获取有效的 SiteId。</notice>
parameters.name: site_id
